sub_scenario.one_line: payroll manager: the streak has a door; the bench broke it

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the payroll register and closing stale entries.
The cutoff calendar review wrapped early today.
Vendor meetings and team one-on-ones in open spaces are perfectly comfortable.
Someone new shadowed me in the finance room this morning.
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the batch runs into one message before lunch.
Our error-free payroll streak, twenty-nine consecutive cycles, was built running cutoff days from the enclosed finance room with interruptions physically impossible.
Non-cutoff weeks I work happily from the open bench like everyone else.
The requirement is periodic, not constant.
I archived last cycle's notes on the cutoff calendar and set up the new folder.
As fresh as these things get.
Payroll errors are the single fastest destroyer of employee trust, per our own engagement surveys.
The stakes are cultural as well as financial.
A vendor call about the payroll register ran long but ended well.
I walked through the finance room checklist with the new starter.
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the batch runs.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the cutoff calendar records and fixed it at the source.
The one cutoff run since facilities converted the finance room to bookable space happened at the open bench, and it produced a duplicated batch requiring an off-cycle correction.
First open-bench cutoff, first correction in twenty-nine cycles.
I sketched next week's plan for the batch runs before leaving.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the payroll register updates.
Off-cycle corrections cost triple processing fees and require director sign-off.
The failure mode is expensive and visible.
I compared two options for the cutoff calendar tooling and noted a mild preference.
I closed the week by updating the finance room handover notes.
I block-book the old finance room for every cutoff week and the office manager asked me to justify the standing booking. What does my record support?
